brief:
Israel's national security minister Itamar Ben-Gvir is positioning himself for the defence minister post in upcoming October elections, Al Jazeera English reported. The move reflects Ben-Gvir's ambitions to expand his political influence within the Israeli government.

Ben-Gvir currently holds the national security portfolio, a position that gives him significant authority over security matters. His bid for the defence ministry signals potential shifts in Israel's security leadership ahead of the electoral contest.
dek: In October elections, Israel’s national security minister Itamar Ben-Gvir is hoping to become defence minister.
title: Ben-Gvir seeks defence minister role ahead of October elections
